missing_preparation_receipt.reason: supertraverse C6 classifies a dependency-eligible upfront leaf with a missing S5 receipt as NEEDS-REFINEMENT; it is neither an execution target nor executable code work.

legacy_single_leaf_repair.reason: superreplan's incremental/legacy wrapper requires the valid adopted C8 record and preserves the one repair-requested row as a single-leaf successor without an upfront batch.

supervisor_native_refinement.reason: superagent WAITING FOR PLAN selects PLAN_REFINER for the first dependency-eligible S5 NEEDS-REFINEMENT stage and persists PLANNING before one heavy dispatch; role pins resolve env before .superenv.

supervisor_bridged_refinement.reason: superagent WAITING FOR PLAN selects the first eligible NEEDS-REFINEMENT stage for PLAN_REFINER; an available bridged relay remains that role's one authorized dispatch and both pins resolve from .superenv.

supervisor_prepared_target.reason: superagent WAITING FOR PLAN sends a valid prepared upfront target straight to WAITING FOR RUN, clears planning hints, and ends the branch with zero heavy dispatches.

supervisor_adopted_legacy_repair.reason: superagent selects superreplan/REPLANNER for the reconciled adopted legacy C8 repair; equal role pins do not couple roles, and this role's pins resolve from .superenv.

supervisor_adopted_batch_repair.reason: superagent selects REPLANNER for the committed pending upfront Active replan record and persists PLANNING for the one replan dispatch; each REPLANNER pin resolves independently.

supervisor_stale_hints.reason: superloop L2 crash recovery restores WAITING FOR PLAN, and superagent reconciliation makes tracked artifacts override stale planning hints; the committed active D-302 batch selects REPLANNER.

supervisor_post_leaf_refinement.reason: after verified leaf closeout the handler returns to WAITING FOR PLAN; superagent then selects the first eligible unprepared S02 for PLAN_REFINER, using harness defaults when neither role pin is supplied.

supervisor_execution_replan_required.reason: superagent gives a superrun REPLAN-REQUIRED result priority and uses the decision ladder; when its rungs cannot resolve authority, it parks at WAITING FOR INPUT rather than selecting an independently prepared stage.

supervisor_legacy_incremental_planning.reason: supertraverse C6 preserves unmarked legacy roots regardless of an environment upfront default, so superagent selects ordinary superplan under PLANNER for the unplanned P1 leaf.

supervisor_missing_native_definition.reason: superagent requires the generated native role definition for this pinned Claude PLAN_REFINER dispatch; its absence is a hard failed dispatch with no authorized fallback and enters the decision ladder.

supervisor_missing_bridge_cli.reason: superagent treats a missing bridged role CLI/relay as a clear failed REPLANNER dispatch, never substitutes another role, and routes the unresolved failure through the decision ladder.
